config.notes: ACU (www.acu.edu.au). Page kinds: /course/<slug> course pages (stored in the DOMESTIC view: fees are CSP or domestic fee-paying, no CRICOS code shown); /handbook/handbook-YYYY/course/ pages (no dates or fees; 2021-2024 are archived years); /study-at-acu/find-a-course/new-courses/ landing pages listing several CRICOS codes (no dates or fees). Intakes: course page panel "Start dates Semester 1 intake: Beginning March 2027 ... Midyear (Semester 2) intake: Beginning August 2027 / Not offered"; the pattern reads only the Beginning months, never "Applications open" months. Other forms: "Start dates February, July 2027", "Professional Term 2 - February 2027". Central key dates: https://www.acu.edu.au/study-at-acu/important-dates (2027 Semester 1 starts Mon 1 Mar, Semester 2 Mon 2 Aug). IELTS: Entry requirements section when printed; otherwise central Admission to Coursework Programs Policy Schedule 4 (https://policy.acu.edu.au/document/view.php?id=312&version=2). Fee: read only when the page is the international view (CRICOS Code then "Fees (first year)* $N" without CSP/Fee-paying). Duration: "Duration N years full-time". AQF: "AQF framework <Award> - AQF Level N".
